text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — we've been invited to run an after-hours 'Dev Salon' Saturday night next to the expo floor. Tiny footprint (8ft table + 2 stools) but there's a 3x 10-min lightning demo block on the demo stage. I want us to do: live Redwood Optimize demo, 90s latency trade talk, and an open Q&A. Also thinking "mystery swag kits" (fun, low-cost) + QR that signs people up for the webinar + benchmark PDF. Who can take speaker submissions, staffing, and swag ordering? Need final qty & pickup plan by Wed. :speaker::package:

anya: I can own onsite logistics and speaker intake. I'll spin up a Google Form for submissions and time slots. Budget check — how much are we ok spending on swag? Also need to confirm storage at the hotel (free vs charged).

sam: I'll own lead routing and automated funnel. Plan: QR -> short form (email, company, primary use-case, interest flags) -> tag responses as "dev-salon" -> webhook to marketing CRM -> immediate 1-email thank you with webinar invite + benchmark PDF. Routing rules we'll use: demos/interested-in-dedicated -> sales-assist queue; others -> webinar drip. Drafting copy now. :iphone:

miguel: For swag courier recs: ShipIt and ExpoDrop both do hotel delivery. Need dims/weight. If budget < $1k we can do 200 mystery kits (sticker, enamel pin, seed packet, fold card w/QR). If we can stretch to $2k, add a branded micro-notebook. Hotel storage windows are usually 48hrs pre-event.

jordan: Design mockup notes — sticker sheet (two sizes), one enamel pin (simple outline), fold card that folds into a tiny stand with QR on the back. Color: deep teal + white logo. I can't attach here, will post Figma link in the #design channel. If anyone wants alternate copy for the card (fun vs technical), say now. :art:

olivia: Quick legal note — can't call anything "benchmark" unless we link the methodology. I can do a one-paragraph methodology blurb and get legal to sign off by Monday. Also pinging security about data retention for QR form responses.

events-bot: Calendar update: "Dev Salon — Redwood slot" scheduled Sat 18:00-20:30 in Satellite Room B. Demo stage block booked 19:00-19:30. /remind @rachel 3 days before the event.

rachel: Nice — thanks. Action items recap: Anya -> Google Form + speaker intake by Tue. Jordan -> finalize mockups + send to merch vendor by Fri. Miguel -> confirm courier and hotel storage Mon and share weight/dim numbers. Sam -> final QR funnel + email copy + CRM webhook by Wed. Olivia -> legal + security check Mon.

rachel: Also need volunteers for staffing the table: 18:45-20:15 (1 person to hand out kits + 1 person to run live demo at 19:00). Who can take a slot? :raised_hands: 

sam: I can do 18:45-19:30 — will handle QR scan flow and demo handoff. :+1:

anya: I can cover 19:30-20:15 and handle speaker sign-in + hand out remaining kits.

miguel: On courier: I'll get shipping quote today and confirm morning pickup. Will post tracking.

jordan: I'll post the final Figma + export specs by Thu EOD.

olivia: Legal will draft the benchmark methodology blurb and confirm wording by Mon noon.

rachel: Perfect. If anyone has ideas for a tiny interactive moment (one-sentence prompt people can try on their phones) add them here — would love something that ties to our cost/latency bench narrative.

sam: Idea for interactive prompt: "Paste a short product description and we'll show estimated inference cost per 1k tokens using Redwood Optimize's config suggestions" — QR leads to a tiny sandbox + cost estimate. Could be a big draw.

rachel: Love it. Sam, can you prototype a one-question cost estimator for the thank-you flow? If yes, prioritize that in the funnel.

sam: Will do. Prototype by Tue morning.

rachel: Thanks team — I'll compile this into a runbook and post before EOD. :sparkles:
